COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-13 commit 8933bef. 26 content files + 8 ADRs. Methodology v1.4. STAGES DONE THROUGH 18.6. Spine: 21 stages (18 + inserted 16.5, 18.5, 18.6).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST.

STAGE 18.6 = 1 TIMOTHY 4 UNDER FULL PRESSURE (00s sections 27b-d). NOT SOFTENED.

METHOD DEMONSTRATED: the OPPOSING argument was given its STRONGEST form FIRST, before any response — 'Yahweh created pigs; everything created by God is good; nothing is to be rejected; therefore pigs may be eaten.' Acknowledged as a perfectly understandable reading of v.4.

THEN: identify the error Paul confronts. Opponents FORBID MARRIAGE **and** require abstinence from foods = ASCETIC PAIRING. 'Which animals did Yahweh designate as food?' is A DIFFERENT QUESTION. May overlap; not automatically the same. Methodologically identical to Mark 7 (Contextual Question Principle).

*** KEY STRUCTURAL FINDING, INDEPENDENT OF LEXICOGRAPHY *** Paul's proposition CANNOT be 'everything Yahweh created must therefore be eaten' — Yahweh created POISONOUS PLANTS, TOXIC FUNGI, INSECTS, PREDATORS, AND HUMAN BEINGS. 'CREATED BY GOD' PLAINLY CANNOT BY ITSELF MEAN 'THEREFORE EDIBLE.' THEREFORE V.4 MUST OPERATE INSIDE V.3'S CATEGORY: **FOODS** (bromaton; RVR1960 'alimentos') that God created to be received. Anyone applying v.4 without v.3's qualifier owes an account of why the same logic doesn't license eating anything Yahweh made. Open q 37.

V.5 'SANCTIFIED BY THE WORD OF GOD **AND** PRAYER' (hagiazetai, dia logou theou kai enteuxeos). FOUR CANDIDATES for 'the word of God', NONE SELECTED: (a) creative declaration that creation is good; (b) SCRIPTURAL DECLARATIONS IDENTIFYING/PROVIDING FOOD; (c) the gospel/message; (d) combination. DO NOT announce Paul means Leviticus 11 — he never says 'as written in Leviticus'; that's eisegesis. BUT NEITHER may the phrase be erased into 'prayer makes anything edible' — Paul says WORD OF GOD AND PRAYER, both in his explanation. BLOCKS THE THANKSGIVING SHORTCUT ('pray over it and you can eat anything') by the same test applied anywhere else: 'Yahweh prohibited X but I thanked Him before doing X' — THANKSGIVING DOES NOT INDEPENDENTLY OVERTURN A COMMANDMENT. Open q 36.

GENESIS CLOSES THE LOOP: Gen 1:29 (plants given FOR FOOD) -> Gen 7:2 (clean/not clean) -> Gen 9:3-4 (animals granted, blood restricted) -> Lev 11:47 ('the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that may not be eaten'). SO WHEN PAUL SAYS 'THE WORD OF GOD' THERE GENUINELY IS PRIOR SCRIPTURAL LANGUAGE DESIGNATING WHAT MAY AND MAY NOT BE EATEN. Does NOT prove he invokes Leviticus 11; DOES establish the continuing-food-law reading isn't inventing the concept out of nowhere.

PRESSURE APPLIED IN THE OTHER DIRECTION TOO: if Paul meant 'only Levitically clean animals are foods created to be received', WHY DOESN'T HE SAY THAT? WHY LANGUAGE THIS BROAD? Broad-liberty readers HAVE REAL TEXTUAL EVIDENCE. Paul's language is NOT shrunk merely because a hypothesis needs it shrunk. BALANCED SIX-ROW CLASSIFICATION: ESTABLISHED = Paul opposes teaching requiring abstinence from foods Yahweh created to be received / grounds argument in goodness of creation / says sanctified by word AND prayer. PLAUSIBLE-UNPROVEN = 'word of God' may include scriptural identification of legitimate foods. NOT ESTABLISHED = that prayer transforms a biblically prohibited creature into permitted food; that bromata necessarily excludes every creature Leviticus classified unclean.

THE LANDSCAPE IS NOT ONE BINARY SWITCH (not: UNCLEAN -> Yeshua -> EVERYTHING CLEAN). Six passages, six different questions in view: Daniel 1 = defilement at a pagan king's table / Mark 7 = defilement through unwashed hands / Acts 10 = common vs unclean + Gentile inclusion / Romans 14 = commonness, conscience, community division / 1 Cor 8-10 = idolatry, demons, conscience, fellowship / 1 Tim 4 = ascetic prohibition. TEN CATEGORIES THAT MUST NOT BE COLLAPSED: species / blood / sacrifice / idolatry / ritual defilement / preparation-provenance / conscience / ascetic prohibition / thanksgiving / love of neighbor. Category Collapse at the largest scale yet applied — and the reason 'can Christians eat pork?' was the wrong opening question.

*** NEXT STAGE: ACTS 15:21 *** 'For from ancient generations Moses has had in every city those who proclaim him, for he is read every Sabbath in the synagogues.' BOTH INVESTIGATIONS LANDED ON THE JERUSALEM COUNCIL INDEPENDENTLY — circumcision brought us there (Stage 17), food brought us straight back (18.6). Acts 15's four requirements sit inside an OLDER BIBLICAL MATRIX: Daniel's pagan court / Corinth's idol-meat / GEN 9:4's BLOOD GIVEN TO HUMANITY NOT ISRAEL / Lev 17's ger laws. THEN JAMES ADDS THE SABBATH COMMENT — routinely SKIPPED when the council is summarized as 'Gentiles only had four rules.' READING A: the four are SUFFICIENT; Jewish communities everywhere already hear Moses; council is enabling Jewish/Gentile table fellowship. READING B: the four are INITIAL requirements; Gentiles will hear Moses taught every Sabbath and CONTINUE LEARNING. VERY DIFFERENT CONCLUSIONS. Promoted from bookmark (open q 26) to NEXT INVESTIGATION. James's own comment may reveal how the apostles understood the requirements they had just issued.

STAGE 18'S DESTINATION, now stated precisely enough to be answerable: WHAT DID YAHWEH DESIGNATE AS FOOD, FOR WHOM, UNDER WHICH COVENANTAL ADMINISTRATION — AND WHAT, IF ANYTHING, DOES MESSIAH'S WORK CHANGE ABOUT THOSE DISTINCTIONS? Only then can we responsibly ask what obedience should look like now. NOTE: that is COVENANTAL JURISDICTION (built Stage 17) applied to food — the instrument was built two stages before the question that needed it.

STILL STANDING, NOT TO BE DROPPED: Romans 14 day-dispute (q34, 'Sabbath' NOT inserted by default) / Colossians 2's two questions (q35: soma = 'substance' vs 'body of Messiah'; and 'let no one JUDGE you' != 'never observe') / whether Paul's Rom 14 liberty PRESUPPOSES or EXPANDS the edible category / whether Mark 7's participle resolves declaratively (q29) / which word is meant at 1 Tim 4:5 (q36).
